items.summary: Recommendation: preserve containment-only execution and maintain a deferred site-factory pipeline for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net. Exactly one next step: attach its dated readiness packet covering site brief, reusable template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics/affiliate readiness boundaries, compliance checklist, owner approval, legal review, security evidence, measurement plan, rollback point, and explicit launch blocker.
